name: T2 Fan (AUTO / MAX)
description: Fan control for Intel Macs with the Apple T2 chip running Linux (t2fanrd service): one click toggles AUTO and MAX, with Strong, Medium and Quiet AUTO profiles and live CPU temperature and fan RPM.
comments:
Left click: AUTO ↔ MAX.
Right click: AUTO profile, live readings and options.

AUTO profiles:
  Strong: 40–60 °C, logarithmic curve
  Medium: 50–75 °C, linear curve
  Quiet: 60–85 °C, exponential curve

Requires t2fanrd (t2linux project) and Cinnamon.
Tested on a Mac mini 2018 (Macmini8,1) with Cinnamon 6.6.
